# Cyble and QBS Software META & Eurasia Formalise Strategic Partnership at GISEC Global 2026


*Partnership will expand access to Cyble’s AI-native cybersecurity solutions across the Middle East, Africa, and Eurasia*


**DUBAI, UAE, September 22, 2026** — Cyble, a leading AI-native cybersecurity company, today announced a strategic partnership with QBS Software META & Eurasia, formalised at GISEC Global 2026 in Dubai. The agreement marks a significant step in bringing advanced threat intelligence and exposure management capabilities to organisations across one of the world’s fastest-evolving threat regions.


The partnership combines Cyble’s AI-native security platform — spanning threat intelligence,[dark web monitoring](https://cyble.com/solutions/dark-web-monitoring/) , and attack surface management — with QBS Software META & Eurasia’s established regional distribution network.


Together, the two companies will give enterprises and government entities across the Middle East, Africa, and Eurasia faster, more direct access to proactive, intelligence-led defence, at a moment when both the volume and sophistication of cyber threats in the region continue to accelerate.


“The threat landscape across this region is evolving faster than most organisations can track on their own,” said **Beenu Arora, CEO and Co-Founder of Cyble** . “This partnership with QBS Software META & Eurasia isn’t just about distribution — it’s about giving our joint customers earlier visibility into the threats that matter, and the ability to act on that intelligence before it becomes a breach. This signing marks the beginning of a new chapter focused on collaboration, innovation, and creating greater value for our partners and customers.”


“Organizations across the Middle East, Africa, and Eurasia are facing a threat environment that is more complex and fast-moving than ever before,” said **M Mobasseri, CEO of QBS Software META & Central Asia** . “Partnering with Cyble allows us to bring genuinely differentiated, AI-native threat intelligence into our regional channel, giving our customers earlier warning and faster response against the risks that matter most to their business. We’re excited to build on this partnership and deliver real value to organisations across the region.”


Under the agreement, QBS Software META & Eurasia will distribute Cyble’s full solution suite — including **Cyble Vision** , its flagship AI-powered[threat intelligence platform](https://cyble.com/solutions/cyber-threat-intelligence/) — to enterprises and government entities across the META and Eurasia region, expanding regional access to proactive cyber defence as threat volumes and sophistication rise.


The partnership was signed in person at **GISEC Global 2026** in **Dubai, UAE** , one of the world’s largest cybersecurity exhibitions and conferences, underscoring both companies’ commitment to strengthening regional cyber resilience.


**About Cyble**


Cyble is a global, AI-native cybersecurity company specializing in[threat intelligence](https://cyble.com/solutions/cyber-threat-intelligence/) , digital risk protection, and dark web monitoring. Its flagship platform, Cyble Vision, powered by[Blaze AI](https://cyble.com/platforms/blaze-ai/) , delivers rapid threat detection, automated analysis, and contextual insights into ransomware, phishing, and fraud.


**About QBS Software**


QBS Software is the largest channel-only online software marketplace, giving access to over 12,000 SaaS products from 12,500+ publishers on a single platform. With growing operations across the Middle East, Turkey, Africa, and Eurasia, QBS delivers a leading enterprise software procurement platform backed by strong service and product expertise. QBS Software is part of QBS Technology Group.


For more information, visit[www.cyble.com](http://www.cyble.com/) .
